subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, exposed to opted-in plugin hooks, or persisted as session metadata for later conversion reporting?
rationale: The extraction path is bounded, but ctwaClid is ad attribution data and the issue asks for prompt/session visibility, so automation should not choose the payload shape, plugin access, retention, or redaction boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context
options.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Opted-in plugin hook payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without showing the identifier in every prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after maintainers define retention, redaction, export, and deletion behavior.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context
recommendation.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across structured prompt metadata, supplemental context, and security/product boundary work.
